reviews.text: Reh's trimmed some very hard to reach trees with ease. Good communication and professional tree care advice. Area was cleaned up very well. Thank you.
reviews.author: Rose

reviews.text: We had 1 tree dropped and a second tree trimmed. It was done fast. There was some extra work done that was not discussed. It is something I missed, but it was taken care of. Most places would have renegotiated price. I am thankful I chose Rehs.
reviews.author: Steven
